selected_design.description: Group the ten retained wave32 (route, output) owners into one local320 workgroup per output column. Each wave computes and BF16-rounds one route exactly as retained wave4; one 20-byte LDS tuple and one barrier expose those ten route values to thread 0, which replays the registered weighted reducer from +0.0 in slot order.
fallbacks: retained selected_gemv_decode_k1024_wave4_bf16_bf16_out followed by registered weighted_sum_out on explicit disable, key miss, shape/backend miss, or rows/prefill
retained serial_weighted schedule remains the deeper exact rollback
no gfx1151 alias until independently implemented and measured
selected_design.name: exact IQ3 K1024 ten-wave route-parallel fused weighted down
ownership_invariants: The same 45 IQ3 layers and ten selected route rows are covered; every route/output still has one physical wave32 and all weight/activation addresses are unchanged.

Each wave retains four K256 accumulators, the same lane*8 activation groups, IQ3 codebook/sign/scale reconstruction, scalar FMA order, five-step shuffle trees, 0..3 partition addition, and BF16 route rounding.
The final thread starts from +0.0 and applies the same ten F32 routing weights with fmaf in slot order before the same BF16 output store.
No persistent weight copy, sidecar, workspace, allocation, activation quantization, prompt/token condition, or output-row tiling is introduced.

One candidate call replaces one retained producer plus one weighted-reducer call on each of 45 IQ3 layers, so the intended complete-model topology is 678 rather than 723 kernels/token; the two non-IQ3 layer reducers remain unchanged.
selected_design.scope: gfx1100 c=1 only, top_k=10, raw IQ3_XXS, K1024/N3072, BF16 activation/output, F32 routing weights; retained wave4 producer plus registered weighted_sum remains fallback
selected_design.why_distinct: P0 route-parallel wave4 kept the producer and reducer as two launches. The rejected historical weighted composite serialized ten routes inside one local128 output owner, while rejected row4 serialized routes to share activations. This design preserves all ten route waves in parallel and changes only their workgroup grouping plus the producer/reducer boundary.
